findings.detail: Cosmetic comment mismatch: the section header comment reads `// academics.* (12)` but exactly 11 academics.* audit-action keys follow (session.created|updated|activated|closed, term.created|updated|activated|closed, program.created|updated, calendar.updated). 11 is the correct count per design §7 and the migration seed; only the comment's parenthetical is stale.
